title: ChoiceRank: code and aggregate results for "Typed Decision Models as Passage Rerankers: Effectiveness, Calibration, and Context Selection"
description: Code, prompts, split IDs, input hashes, and aggregate result tables for evaluating typed decision models (Jev, Clef, Jeff, Laya) as passage rerankers on TREC DL 2019-2023 and eight BEIR collections, their calibration, and their use for context selection in retrieval-augmented generation on MuSiQue and NQ. Raw per-pair model outputs and downloaded datasets are not included.
